Name: Simple Tea Expansion
Author: omena007
Description:
This mod adds four new types of tea:

Black Tea (Red Tea, 紅茶)
The most basic tea for many people. More oxidized than green tea.
[list]
[*]add 1 tea leaf to (de)hydrator to oxidize it into black tea.[/*]
[/list]
Dark Tea (Fermented Tea, 黑茶)
Pu'er is one of the most famous types of this tea. Mushroomy taste and very healthy.
[list]
[*]add 1 tea leaf to cask to ferment it into dark tea. To further age it, re-apply[/*]
[/list]
Matcha (抹茶)
Fresh umami grassy tasting tea. A bamboo whisk is used to make it.
[list]
[*]add 1 tea leaf to mill to pulverize it.[/*]
[/list]
Floral Tea (Infusion)
Not actually a tea but the technique is similar. It felt weird the dehydrator did nothing to flowers so here we are.
[list]
[*]add 5 any types of flowers to dehydrator to dry them into an infusion.[/*]
[/list]
My original plan was to make a custom category for tea items so that eg iced tea could use any tea type in the recipe but apparently that can't be achieved with just content patcher so I left it be. 

[color=#6aa84f]There is a a config option to toggle on/off the floral tea making since some other mods use dehydrator as well.[/color]

Tea recipes are unlocked by different requirements and some come as letters.

[size=4]Recipes & Unlocking conditions:[/size]

[spoiler]

Taro Bubble Tea: sold at Resort Bar
Nice Cup of Tea: Farming level 2
Afternoon Tea: 8 hearts with Evelyn
Matcha Roll Cake: 8 hearts with Caroline
Fairy Tea: Complete Community Center or build Joja storehouse
Peach Iced Tea: Farming level 7
Matcha: Ship 1 matcha powder
Strawberry Matcha Latte: sold at Saloon
[/spoiler]
